text: An immutable CalRecurrenceRule caches its iterator, start and calculated values. New calls replay cached values and extend the same iterator only as the consumer needs more. A different compared start throws; mutable rules use fresh iterators. Range and count stops still apply, and the first out-of-range candidate may already be cached. RecurrenceInfo propagates immutability to its rules. No runtime or performance test was run, and the edited tests do not directly assert cache reuse.
title: Immutable recurrence rules replay an instance cache with one fixed start
